reviews.text:
I had an appointment today at 11:00 AM, and when I arrived, they hadn't taken my appointment. There was no groomer available. I went back home. This meant wasted time at work, and my dog ​​didn't get his hair washed and cut.
A word of advice: Get your act together and check your messages and your schedule instead of just sitting on a park bench outside. This is what makes the difference. You're losing clients this way.
Good afternoon.
Lots of things for our furry friends
Excellent service
I was delighted, and so was my dog; she came out looking beautiful and happy. I'll definitely be back!

A complete scam. I had an appointment at 12, but at 11:20 they called to say there had been a problem and asked if I could bring the dog at 6 pm. I agreed. The groomer there told me it would take at least a couple of hours. At 8 pm I went there and from outside the shop I could see there was no activity inside. I saw the girl go out a door and go back a couple of times, I couldn't see what was going on, but I saw my dog ​​put his paws up right in front of me and then put them down again, twice. She had already finished with him who knows how long ago, at least the 15 minutes I had been there. The dog was on a leash and the other woman was just stalling. Normally at the other groomer I go to they tell me: "He'll be here in 10 minutes." Here, it turns out that just as I walked in, seeing the scene, she had just finished. I was totally ripped off. In short... The dog was poorly washed, the haircut was awful—not even remotely breed-appropriate—and the tail wasn't docked. And it cost €65 (he's a medium-sized dog, 19 kg, and a very sweet boy). The girl was arrogant and everything was terrible. Never again.

Since the business was taken over, it's been a disaster... everything goes wrong for them, even scheduling appointments, they think it's a huge deal to cut a dog's nails, they have very little desire to work
Delighted with this service, they always leave my furry friend looking spectacular. Always grateful.
When things are done with enthusiasm and care, the result is good. Happy with the service and very happy with the outcome. Highly recommended.

Excellent grooming salon, with top-notch professionals, especially Camila, who does all kinds of cuts. In my case, she did a great cut on my Giant Poodle, and the result was beautiful and perfectly styled. They are very attentive and treat the animals with great care. They use top-quality products, like the shampoo that leaves the coat shiny and incredibly soft. Highly recommended, and the price is unbeatable for the excellent, high-quality, and friendly service they provide. They are 100% professional and treat animals with the utmost care.
I took my dog ​​in and I loved the haircut they gave him on Monday.
It's been a disaster since the new owners took over. I had to take her back three times just to get her halfway decent. She had cuts and a terrible haircut. I'm never going back.

I'm giving one star because it won't let me give zero. The previous owners did a fantastic job, but the current ones have no idea about breed-specific grooming, and I noticed the dog didn't smell good. In conclusion, a horrible experience. I will never take her there again 😡 …
Horrible. Terrible punctuality. And my dog's haircut was awful. We won't be back.

They kept my small dog for three and a half hours, even though my appointment was for 4:30. I picked her up at 8:00 and she was loose. The shop assistant and the groomer were incredibly rude, and on top of that, they didn't give her a proper haircut. I had been warned about this, but I won't be going back. DO NOT LEAVE YOUR PETS THERE; THEY TREAT THEM TERRIBLY. The owners used to be lovely.
I love them
They pamper Baloo with all the love in the world whenever we go
It's a very nice and special pet grooming salon; they are excellent with pets and their owners, and the service is very good.
My dogs look gorgeous! I loved this groomer: they're very professional, caring, and reasonably priced. We'll definitely be back! Thank you!
The service and attention are unbeatable. My dog ​​always leaves very happy; I'm extremely satisfied with the service.
My dog ​​comes out very happy and very clean, and they always treat us with great kindness. I'm very satisfied with the service and I recommend it 100%.

We've been taking Milo there since he was a baby, and we have complete trust in the owners. Seeing Milo go in happy and come out looking so handsome and calm is the best proof of their professionalism and the care they put into their work!
I take my dog ​​Lilo there every month, and the care and attention they provide are perfect. Thank you so much.

Yesterday I took my Maltese Bilchon to the groomer, and I'm not happy with the cut. He has a lot of uneven patches, and even after sending them a picture of how I want him to look and explaining the shape, they do the exact opposite. They cut his hair too short and badly.
And the cut is terrible.
I definitely won't be going back.
We appreciate reviews, as long as the customer identifies themselves. It's not right to leave anonymous reviews from people who aren't customers just to lower our ratings.
Thank you so much for your rating...
I'm so happy with how they did with Pipa. We'll be back!
The service is friendly and professional, the products are high quality and affordable.
Thank you for your review
Excellent hairdressing service. Great service, expert and caring professional.
Excellent service and a perfect result. Very happy, and so is our furry friend.
I take my toy poodle there and they make him look gorgeous! Thank you so much, excellent service!
It was my first time taking my dog ​​and they treated him very well. I'll be back.
Hello... we would like to know your pet's name and when we attended to them, as your name is not in our records.
I was very pleased with how they treated our dog. Boira is a Shih Tzu. We'll definitely be back. Very happy with the service.
By far the best dog groomer, they do a fantastic job, they pay attention to every little detail when it comes to the animal's appearance.
